note: Entry point of the crypto:rc4_decrypt EXSLT function; receives the XPath context with the key and hex ciphertext arguments.
Pops the hex-encoded ciphertext string from the XPath stack; this is attacker-controlled input from the XSLT stylesheet.
Pops the RC4 key string from the XPath stack; also attacker-controlled.
Computes the decrypted output length as half the hex string length; the hex ciphertext is decoded to raw bytes.
Allocates a buffer for the decrypted bytes plus a NUL terminator; no UTF-8 validation is performed on the resulting bytes.

code: exsltCryptoGcryptRc4Decrypt(ctxt, key, msg, msglen, dest, destlen)
note: Calls the platform RC4 decrypt routine which XORs the keystream with the decoded ciphertext, producing arbitrary raw bytes including invalid UTF-8 sequences.
Returns the decrypted raw bytes as an XPath string without any UTF-8 validity check; invalid UTF-8 bytes flow into the XSLT result tree.
The XSLT result containing invalid UTF-8 bytes is serialized; libxml2's UTF-8 handling encounters the malformed sequence and triggers the memory-safety failure.
